derivation: Reconstruct unique insertion endpoints from consecutive committed interval rows, requiring identical duplicate endpoints and101 consecutive source lines strictly bracketing the200-round admission window. Count every matching program/context insertion and every adapter accepted flag by round; cumulative values are exact prefix sums starting at the window boundary.
zero_count_basis: The complete consecutive insertion history has events on both sides of the chosen window; rounds with no matched insertion therefore contribute zero recorded events. Every adapter decision has an explicit accepted flag.
join_scope: Logged round identifiers only; no assertion of joined evaluator/population/normalization or source/runtime qualification. The two event counts have distinct meanings and do not measure independent learning, proposal quality or speed.
